text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, and I’m a machine learning developer with 6 years of experience building production systems in Python.

I’ve built a product recommendations engine for Tidewater Outfitters, where I trained similar-items and you-may-also-like carousels on 1.2M interactions and cached results in Redis; it increased click-through rate by 14% in a 4-week A/B test. I also built a support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co., routing incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues with FastAPI and nightly retraining through Celery on Redis; it reached macro-F1 0.88 vs 0.62 for the old rules and cut median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes.

While my background is in Python and ML rather than Netty specifically, I’m comfortable with performance-focused systems work, test automation, and refactoring complex codebases. I’d be glad to help validate behavior, build robust test suites, and improve reliability and performance.
